import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
w=w[w.year.notna()].copy()
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages;w['late']=w.year>=1876
print(len(w),w[c].mean())
g=w.groupby(['genre','late']).r.agg(['mean','size']).unstack();print(g)
def est(d):
  m=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack();return (m[True]-m[False]).mean()
print('est',est(w))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
gs=[x for _,x in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
for i in range(2000):
  bs.append(est(pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in gs])))
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for dc in ['high','medium','low']: print(dc,est(w[w.date_confidence==dc]))
print('hi+med',est(w[w.date_confidence!='low']))
print('1856-1896',est(w[(w.year>1856)&(w.year<1896)]))
for o in ['UK','US','unknown']: print(o,est(w[w.origin==o]))
print(w.groupby('decade').r.mean())
p=pd.read_parquet('passages.parquet');pp=p[p.domains.apply(lambda d:'DISTANCE_TRAVEL' in list(d))].merge(w[['work_id','year']],on='work_id')
print(pp.sort_values('confidence',ascending=False).head(8)[['passage_id','year','confidence']])
"
